body: Founder: 'can we start crunching the data on the heroes that are the strongest? does our match replay system let us start tracking stats like win rate etc?' Checked: neither var/matches/*.jsonl nor IDUNA's player_game_stats table ever recorded hero_id, only win/loss. Rather than a cross-repo IDUNA migration, kept this self-contained: new match_log_draft_complete() writes {owner,team,hero_id} once per match when draft finishes; new scripts/hero_stats.py joins that against match_end's winner to compute win rate per hero from local logs. Flagged plainly: the 5860 pre-existing match logs are unusable for this (no hero_id ever recorded), so stats start from zero real games going forward, not a backfill. Full suite green.
title: feat: hero win-rate tracking from real match logs
